svg.title: Operate a Bid Desk, Not an Influence Channel
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-bid-desk-delivery-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: Operate a Bid Desk, Not an Influence Channel; subtitle: Five evidence-backed handoffs from supplier intake to service billing.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The operator sells procurement support to supplier clients. Government contract face value and subcontract principal remain outside recognized operator service revenue. Federal and municipal solicitations require separate rule matrices.; caption: Automate solicitation alerts, bid calendars, and checklist reminders; retain named human ownership of eligibility, pricing, and submission.; stages: label: Qualify the supplier; value: Document delivery capacity before pursuit; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record client authority, past performance, delivery resources, cash requirements, and conflicts. Check SAM.gov registration and exclusions where relevant; verify claimed set-aside status rather than treating a profile entry as sufficient evidence.; label: Screen the opportunity; value: Match requirements against documented capability; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use SAM.gov saved searches and municipal purchasing portals. Extract mandatory qualifications, place of performance, response deadlines, amendments, and evaluation factors into a solicitation matrix with a named pursuit owner.; label: Design the service; value: Separate fees from contract principal; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Define fixed-scope or retainer deliverables, client responsibilities, and acceptance evidence. Review contingent-fee restrictions and proposed teaming structures before signing; a fixed fee does not cure prohibited conduct.; label: Prepare and submit; value: Control versions, amendments, and receipts; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Maintain a dated bid calendar, assign technical sections, validate required representations, and obtain client signoff. Have the authorized submitter retain the final package, amendment acknowledgments, and portal receipt.; label: Deliver and collect; value: Invoice accepted procurement support services; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Record completed service milestones and invoice under the client agreement. Track receivables aging and supplier performance separately; recognize earned service fees without booking the client's government award as operator revenue.

text.title: Operate a Bid Desk, Not an Influence Channel

circle.title: label: Qualify the supplier; value: Document delivery capacity before pursuit; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record client authority, past performance, delivery resources, cash requirements, and conflicts. Check SAM.gov registration and exclusions where relevant; verify claimed set-aside status rather than treating a profile entry as sufficient evidence.

text.title: Record client authority, past performance, delivery resources, cash requirements, and conflicts. Check SAM.gov registration and exclusions where relevant; verify claimed set-aside status rather than treating a profile entry as sufficient evidence.

circle.title: label: Screen the opportunity; value: Match requirements against documented capability; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use SAM.gov saved searches and municipal purchasing portals. Extract mandatory qualifications, place of performance, response deadlines, amendments, and evaluation factors into a solicitation matrix with a named pursuit owner.

text.title: Use SAM.gov saved searches and municipal purchasing portals. Extract mandatory qualifications, place of performance, response deadlines, amendments, and evaluation factors into a solicitation matrix with a named pursuit owner.

circle.title: label: Design the service; value: Separate fees from contract principal; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Define fixed-scope or retainer deliverables, client responsibilities, and acceptance evidence. Review contingent-fee restrictions and proposed teaming structures before signing; a fixed fee does not cure prohibited conduct.

text.title: Define fixed-scope or retainer deliverables, client responsibilities, and acceptance evidence. Review contingent-fee restrictions and proposed teaming structures before signing; a fixed fee does not cure prohibited conduct.

circle.title: label: Prepare and submit; value: Control versions, amendments, and receipts; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Maintain a dated bid calendar, assign technical sections, validate required representations, and obtain client signoff. Have the authorized submitter retain the final package, amendment acknowledgments, and portal receipt.

text.title: Maintain a dated bid calendar, assign technical sections, validate required representations, and obtain client signoff. Have the authorized submitter retain the final package, amendment acknowledgments, and portal receipt.

circle.title: label: Deliver and collect; value: Invoice accepted procurement support services; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Record completed service milestones and invoice under the client agreement. Track receivables aging and supplier performance separately; recognize earned service fees without booking the client's government award as operator revenue.

text.title: Record completed service milestones and invoice under the client agreement. Track receivables aging and supplier performance separately; recognize earned service fees without booking the client's government award as operator revenue.

Assumptions: The operator sells procurement support to supplier clients. Government contract face value and subcontract principal remain outside recognized operator service revenue. Federal and municipal solicitations require separate rule matrices.
